description: Brazil STAR Project Microgrid Monitoring Data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Elena Gaura, Alessandro Bezerra Trindade (Coventry University). Contains monitoring data from microgrids deployed in rural areas of the State of Amazonas, Brazil. The data collections started in January of 2018 and ended in March 2019. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
